finding: AgentCore Evaluations API scored 5 real analytics engine sessions using 3 built-in evaluators. 15/15 evaluation calls succeeded. Scores returned within seconds. No changes to agent instrumentation were required — spans were constructed from existing CloudWatch log data.

prerequisitesFixed.iam: Added inline policy BedrockAgentCoreEvaluate to anshaff.ameer (put-user-policy, anshaff.ameer had iam:PutUserPolicy permission). One-time setup.
prerequisitesFixed.spanFormat: Spans constructed from CloudWatch application logs (sessionId, requestId, tool sequence, timestamps). Format: OTel flat span per sessionSpans entry, scope embedded as field with name=strands.telemetry.tracer. Required field discovery: kind=string (not int), status.code=string, tool spans need output.value attribute.

scores.note: Real signal: evaluator judged that returning a schema preview without addressing the user's actual question did not meet the goal. This is a genuine quality finding, not a tooling artifact.

spanFields.scope.name: strands.telemetry.tracer
spanFields.output.value: inferred from session context (tool outputs are domain-plausible, not captured from real logs)

spanConstructionMethod.caveat: Tool output values are inferred, not captured from real logs. Real OTel instrumentation would provide exact tool outputs, improving evaluator accuracy.

openQuestions.instrumentation: Adding native OTel to the agent (configure_otel_tracer) would make span construction automatic and exact. Without it, tool output values must be inferred from application logs — adequate for quality sampling, not for exact regression testing.
openQuestions.b2: Pending Sekar: what constitutes DQ rules and certified metric baselines in this system?
